description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Debt Recovery (Special Provision) Act, Notification under Section 30
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under Section 30 of the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No. 02 of 1990. It establishes a new regulatory requirement by setting the Market Rate of Interest for debt recovery purposes. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the implementation and modification of statutory regulations and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
